title: Open WebUI terminal WebSocket -- T1548 pending-role account reaches terminal despite unapproved status
author: WinstonRedGuard -- sigma plugin observed rules (derived from breach corpus)
description:
Vendor-disclosed detection for CVE-2026-70490 (GHSA-5gpj-vj23-vhhv,
CVSS 6.3 MEDIUM), affecting Open WebUI from 0.8.8 until 0.11.0.

`backend/open_webui/routers/terminals.py`'s terminal WebSocket route
authenticates its own first-message JWT but never applies the
verified-user role gate that `get_verified_user` enforces on the
equivalent HTTP terminal routes. An account whose role is `pending` --
a registered-but-not-yet-approved signup, or an account an
administrator deactivated back to pending -- can open an interactive
terminal session over WebSocket as long as at least one terminal
server is configured and its access grants cover that account. This
quietly loses the account-approval boundary specifically for terminal
access, while the HTTP terminal routes on the same feature correctly
reject the identical account.

Detection logic flags a successful terminal WebSocket connection whose
authenticating JWT belongs to a `pending`-role account -- the same
account the HTTP terminal routes would reject, reaching an interactive
shell through the one code path that forgot to check.

Aggregated from 1 first-party vendor security advisory (open-webui, via
GHSA and NVD, citing the exact router file), fixed in 0.11.0.
